projectcatalyst.caption: Explore the latest funding round
projectcatalyst.text: Project Catalyst launches funding rounds every few months, allocating ADA to innovative ideas. Stay up to date with the latest proposals, voting timelines, and insights from past and upcoming funds.

ideascale.caption: Get to know all proposals.
ideascale.text: Jump in and participate on the collaborative innovation platform. Explore community-driven proposals and take part by voting on the ideas that aim to solve real-world challenges defined in each funding round.

newsletter.caption: Stay up to date
newsletter.text: Sign up for the Project Catalyst Newsletter so you don't miss out on the latest news and updates.

engage.caption: Engage with the community
engage.text: Join the Telegram discussion and announcement channels to share your ideas on future Cardano improvement proposals and enjoy a healthy, stimulating discussion.

townhall.caption: Weekly updates, project showcases, and community connection.
townhall.text: Catch weekly updates from the Catalyst team and see real project impact live at the Town Hall. Live on zoom, X, and YouTube. Stick around for community breakout rooms after the stream!
